text: Good morning. Happy rainy Wednesday. Can't have the sunshine without the rain. We have lots of rain, so we're going to go ahead and get started. With that, Dr. Bridges, do you have a motion for us?

I do. Thank you. I move that the Virginia Board of Education convene in a closed meeting for the following purposes, discussion or consideration by the Board of Ed of information relating to denial, suspension, or revocation of teacher licenses, subject to the exclusion in subdivision 11 of 2.2-3705.3, pursuant to 2.2-3711A40 of the Code of Virginia, and consultation with counsel regarding specific legal matters requiring the provision of legal advice, pursuant to Virginia Code 2.2-3711A8 of the Code of Virginia and that legal counsel to the Virginia

Board of Education and staff whose presence will aid in the board's consideration of this matter participate in the closed meeting. Thank you. There has been a motion. Is there a second? We'll do a roll call. Ms. Reinhart? Aye. Ms. McPherson? Aye. Mr. Robinson? Aye. Dr. Bridges? Aye.
Aye. Dr. Northern. Aye. Mrs. Kilgore. Aye. And Chair Vose, aye. We will now go into closed session. Thank you.
